subject: Error with compilation on command line

messages.author: a158536a9c3502fe
messages.subject: Error with compilation on command line
parts:
Hi there,

NIMBLE works fine within my R application but runs into compilation error when I run the Rscript on command line. I wonder why that is?

I get the following error:
<SHLIBCreationError: Failed to create the shared library. Run 'printErrors()' to see the compilation errors.>
ld: unknown option: -platform_version
clang-10: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
make: *** [dynamicRegistrations_09_22_14_59_17.so] Error 1

Cheers,
Meryl

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: Error with compilation on command line
parts:
Hi Meryl,

I'm not able to reproduce this either using MacOs (which I am guessing you are using) or Linux.

I see a similar error reported here, which suggests it might have something to do with the configuration of your compiler.
That said, it seems weird that it would work when using R rather than Rscript.

You might using the "showCompilerOutput = TRUE" option to `compileNimble` when running via R versus via Rscript and
try to see if there is some difference in the compilation and linking steps that are being invoked.

-chris
